verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is SDK-first: every documented capability is exposed programmatically through the Sandbox SDK, so there is no evidence of a UI-only feature an API user would lack. That surface covers sandbox creation and reconnection, command execution with streaming, file I/O, the code interpreter, file watching, preview URLs and tunnels, bucket mounts, snapshots, sessions and terminal WebSockets. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of UI/API parity, evidence of a language-agnostic REST API beyond the Workers-bound TypeScript SDK (the OpenAPI probe is site-wide, not sandbox-specific), and independent hands-on corroboration.
